register_encoder: register a new encoder class in the ENCODER_REGISTRY with a unique name
get_encoder: get an encoder class from the registry by its registered name
SparseVoxelEncoder_ray_intersect: compute ray-voxel intersections using AABB or SVO octree and return sorted depth intervals
SparseVoxelEncoder_pruning: prune sparse voxels below a density threshold to reduce the number of active voxels
SparseVoxelEncoder_export_surfaces: extract triangle meshes from an implicit field using the marching cubes algorithm
